about: Home Depot standalone prices for the validation set's 49 part models, read 2026-11-18 in the owner's Chrome from a homedepot.com tab (fetch('/s/<model>') for the item id, then fetch('/p/<id>') for the page state's pricing value and original; no SerpApi). A product link is taken only when its URL's model equals the part's model, or for RYOBI its one-trailing-B twin (matchedModel says which); otherwise nulls. Not found: DCB203-2, PCL206, DCB346-3, P119. Titles had runs of spaces collapsed.
